title: String Theory
description: Bowed, plucked, prepared and bowed again. Strings doing unusual work.
note: Modern composition for strings, mostly. Two of these were recorded in the same church, eleven years apart. You can hear the roof.

artwork.prompt: Playlist cover artwork, square format, evocative rather than literal. A 2015-present cover. Medium: risograph print in two spot inks, visible grain, overprint where they cross. Not a depiction — an abstract composition that only distantly evokes a thin black line bisecting white. Palette: white, graphite, one muted accent. Composition: bold flat shapes, limited palette, halftone texture throughout. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
